mapper.insert: INSERT INTO amz_performance_ranking ( stat_month, principal_name, gross_profit, amount, refund_amount, net_sales_amount, create_time, update_time ) SELECT resolved.stat_month, resolved.principal_name, SUM(resolved.gross_profit), SUM(resolved.amount), SUM(resolved.refund_amount), SUM(resolved.amount - resolved.refund_amount), NOW(), NOW() FROM ( SELECT p.stat_month, CASE WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' AND RIGHT(s.store_name, 3) = '-UK' THEN '吴清栩' WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' AND UPPER(p.local_sku) LIKE 'OTH-%' THEN COALESCE( NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(eu_oth.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(eu_oth.principal_name) END, '' ), '未分配' ) WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' THEN COALESCE( NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(eu_brand.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(eu_brand.principal_name) END, '' ), '未分配' ) WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US1-' THEN COALESCE( NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(us1_store.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(us1_store.principal_name) END, '' ), '未分配' ) WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US2-' THEN COALESCE( NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(us2_store.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(us2_store.principal_name) END, '' ), '未分配' ) ELSE '未分配' END AS principal_name, COALESCE(p.gross_profit, 0) AS gross_profit, COALESCE(p.amount, 0) AS amount, COALESCE(p.refund_amount, 0) AS refund_amount FROM amz_monthly_order_profit p JOIN shop_list s ON s.sid = p.sid LEFT JOIN amz_performance_owner_rule eu_brand ON eu_brand.stat_month = p.stat_month AND eu_brand.group_code = 'EU' AND eu_brand.rule_type = 'BRAND' AND eu_brand.match_key = UPPER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.local_sku, '-', 1)) LEFT JOIN amz_performance_owner_rule eu_oth ON eu_oth.stat_month = p.stat_month AND eu_oth.group_code = 'EU' AND eu_oth.rule_type = 'OTH_CODE' AND eu_oth.match_key = UPPER( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.local_sku, '-', 2), '-', -1) ) LEFT JOIN amz_performance_owner_rule us1_store ON us1_store.stat_month = p.stat_month AND us1_store.group_code = 'US1' AND us1_store.rule_type = 'STORE' AND us1_store.match_key = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.store_name, '-', 2), '-', -1 ) = '重庆茁凯' THEN '邱存帅' ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.store_name, '-', 2), '-', -1 ) END LEFT JOIN amz_performance_owner_rule us2_store ON us2_store.stat_month = p.stat_month AND us2_store.group_code = 'US2' AND us2_store.rule_type = 'STORE' AND us2_store.match_key = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.store_name, '-', 2), '-', -1) WHERE p.stat_month = #{statMonth} AND ( LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' OR LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US1-' OR LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US2-' ) ) resolved GROUP BY resolved.stat_month, resolved.principal_name

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' AND RIGHT(s.store_name, 3) = '-UK' THEN '吴清栩' WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' AND UPPER(p.local_sku) LIKE 'OTH-%' THEN NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(eu_oth.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(eu_oth.principal_name) END, '' ) WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' THEN NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(eu_brand.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(eu_brand.principal_name) END, '' ) WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US1-' THEN NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(us1_store.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(us1_store.principal_name) END, '' ) WHEN LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US2-' THEN NULLIF( CASE WHEN TRIM(us2_store.principal_name) IN ('待定', '待到') THEN '' ELSE TRIM(us2_store.principal_name) END, '' ) ELSE NULL END AS principal_name FROM amz_monthly_order_profit p JOIN shop_list s ON s.sid = p.sid LEFT JOIN amz_performance_owner_rule eu_brand ON eu_brand.stat_month = p.stat_month AND p.stat_month AND eu_oth.group_code = 'EU' AND eu_oth.rule_type = 'OTH_CODE' AND eu_oth.match_key = UPPER( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.local_sku, '-', 2), '-', -1) ) LEFT JOIN amz_performance_owner_rule us1_store ON us1_store.stat_month = p.stat_month AND us1_store.group_code = 'US1' AND us1_store.rule_type = 'STORE' AND us1_store.match_key = CASE WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX( us2_store.stat_month = p.stat_month AND us2_store.group_code = 'US2' AND us2_store.rule_type = 'STORE' AND us2_store.match_key = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(s.store_name, '-', 2), '-', -1) WHERE p.stat_month = #{statMonth} AND ( LEFT(s.store_name, 3) = 'EU-' OR LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US1-' OR LEFT(s.store_name, 4) = 'US2-' ) ) resolved WHERE resolved.principal_name IS NULL OR resolved.principal_name = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amz_performance_owner_rule WHERE stat_month = #{statMonth}
